title: Magnet-assisted immunoprecipitation of recombinant protein
author: Marvin De los Santos
materials: Couple the antibodies covalently with Dynabeads M-280 Tosylactivated using the recommended protocol from the manufacturer. For this protocol, the anti-TGF-β1 and anti-PD-L1 antibodies will be used. However, different antibody reagents can be subjected for coupling

steps.title: Prepare Buffer B
steps.instruction: Prepare Buffer B (pH 7.4) by combining the following reagents and filling to 1 L with distilled water (H2O): 2.62 g NaH2PO4 × H2O, 14.42 g Na2HPO4 × 2 H2O, and adjusting pH with NaOH or HCl.

steps.title: Wash Magnet-Coated Beads
steps.instruction: Wash the Dynabeads M-280 Tosylactivated beads to prepare them for coupling.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend Dynabeads in the vial by vortexing for 00:00:30
Transfer 300 µL of beads to a new, sterile 1.5 mL tube
Add 1 mL of Buffer B and vortex for 00:00:30
Place tube in a magnet for 00:01:00 and discard the supernatant; repeat this wash once
Remove tube from magnet and resuspend washed beads in 300 µL of Buffer B
Divide washed beads into two tubes (150 µL each)
Place tubes in a magnet for 00:01:00 and discard the supernatant

steps.title: Couple Antibodies to Beads
steps.instruction: Couple the specific antibodies to the Dynabeads.

substeps.instruction: For every 150 µL of initial Dynabeads volume, resuspend in 100 µg/150 µL of antibodies (anti-TGF-β1 or anti-PD-L1) diluted in Buffer B
Mix by vortexing for 00:00:30

steps.title: Block and Wash Coupled Beads
steps.instruction: Block the beads using Buffer C and Buffer D, then wash with Buffer E.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL Buffer C (composed of 39.64 g [(NH4)2]SO4 in 100 mL Buffer B, pH 7.4) and vortex for 00:00:30
Incubate on a shaker at 37 °C for 16:00:00
Place tube on a magnet for 00:02:00 and remove the supernatant
Remove tube from magnet, add 1 mL Buffer D (composed of 0.88 g NaCl and 0.5% (w/v) BSA in 80 mL Buffer B, pH 7.4), and incubate at 37 °C for 01:00:00 on a shaker
Place tube on a magnet for 00:02:00 and remove the supernatant
Remove tube from magnet, add 1 mL Buffer E, and vortex for 00:00:10
Place tube on a magnet for 00:02:00 and remove the supernatant
Repeat the Buffer E wash (adding 1 mL, vortexing 10s, and magnet separation) once more
For every 150 µL of initial Dynabeads, resuspend and dilute the beads in 200 µL of Buffer E

steps.title: Harvest and Lyse HEK 293 Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest cells and prepare the protein extract.

substeps.instruction: Harvest HEK 293 cells after 48:00:00 of incubation
Decant culture medium and wash cells twice with sterile PBS
Submerge cells in PBS and incubate at 25 °C for 00:01:00
Gently tap the sides of the plate to detach cells and transfer the supernatant
Collect cells by centrifugation at 500 x g, 25 °C, for 5 minutes
For every 1 × 10⁶ cells, resuspend in 500 µL of native protein extraction buffer (50 mM Tris, 1 mM EDTA, 0.001% (w/v) SDS, 0.01% (w/v) Tween-20, 50 mM NaCl, pH 7.4)
Lyse cells by passing the solution through a 23-G needle syringe 15 times gently on ice
Clarify lysate by centrifugation at 500 x g, 25 °C, for 5 minutes
Transfer supernatant to a new sterile tube and store the pellet at -80 °C
Quantify the protein content of the extract using any available laboratory method

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate Recombinant Protein
steps.instruction: Capture the target protein using the antibody-coupled beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µg of sample containing the recombinant protein (e.g., bifunctional fusion protein with TGF-B1 and PD-L1 domains) to 50 µL of the antibody-coupled beads
Prepare two separate reactions for each antibody-coupled Dynabeads (anti-TGF-β1 and anti-PD-L1)
Incubate with tilting and rotation for 00:30:00
Place tube on a magnet for 00:02:00 and pipette off the supernatant
Remove tube from magnet, add 1 mL PBS, and vortex for 00:00:10
Place tube on a magnet for 00:02:00 and remove the supernatant
Repeat the PBS wash (adding 1 mL, vortexing 10s, and magnet separation) twice

steps.title: Elute and Neutralize Protein
steps.instruction: Elute the captured protein and neutralize the solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 100 mM glycine-HCl (pH 3.0) and incubate for 00:01:00
Place tube on a magnet for 00:02:00 and collect the supernatant
Neutralize the collected supernatant by adding 5 µL of 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 8.8)
Optional: Wash beads with 50 µL of 1 M Tris-HCl for reuse

steps.title: Analyze Isolated Protein
steps.instruction: Quantify and verify the purity of the isolated protein.

substeps.instruction: Quantify the concentration of the isolated protein
Analyze purity using SDS-PAGE or other methods
